about: SnowboardRecs starter catalog: snowboards and splitboards from 14 makers, 2025 and 2026 model years (splitboards also 2027), one entry per model and model year as evo.com names them, colourways and sizes merged, women's-only models kept under their own names, kids' boards left out. Read on 2026-10-24 from each board's evo.com product page. Category comes from evo's terrain list: Powder, or Freeride listed first, makes a Freeride snowboard; Freestyle listed first a Freestyle snowboard; otherwise All-mountain. Terrain, profile (evo's rocker type, in the maker's own words), shape and flex are as the page states them; blank where the page gives none or gives only sidecut tech. Bindings and boots are not included: Burton and thirtytwo don't give them model years. Older model years (2010–2024) are added only for boards with 3 or more first-hand rider reviews, read on 2026-10-27 from that year's evo.com page (live outlet page, or its web.archive.org copy where evo now redirects to the current model).
